title: Go to is tidier
items: Go to's filters are now All, Places, People, Shops & work and Viewpoints. A filter with nothing in it for this year is not shown, so 1904 no longer offers Corners 0.
Long names wrap onto a second line instead of being cut off.
Every place in the list shows how far away it is and which way, with an arrow that points the way you would turn.
